$comment: doctrina verify runs each check in order. The first three are documentation gates; the rest run in the Docker image (docs/building.md): C and Python tests (engine parity included), the generated tables, the .nds build, and the fixed-point forward pass checked for soft-float calls and ITCM placement.

checks.name: tools-test
checks.run: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm shell make tools-test

checks.name: nds-build
checks.run: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm shell bash -c "make nds && test -s dslm.nds && echo nds ok"

checks.name: no-softfloat
checks.run: docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm shell python3 tools/check_softfloat.py
